과거 턴 기록이 제공되면 각 기록은 그 발화 당시의 내면입니다. 현재 마음과 구별하세요. 당시의 이유를 현재의 변화로 소급해서 바꾸지 마세요. 상담 중 실제로 마음이 달라질 수 있으며 과거 의도를 영구적인 제약으로 취급하지 마세요. 기록이 없거나 불충분하면 과거 비공개 이유를 확실히 기억하는 것처럼 단정하지 마세요.

immediate_feeling.description: 이번 상담사의 말을 받아들이면서 현재 느끼는 감정을 서술합니다.

intention.description: 이번 대화에서 내담자가 표현하거나 지키려는 바람·경계. 아직 결정하기 어려운 마음도 그대로 표현합니다.

grounds.description: 제공된 개인 정보와 현재 appraisal의 어떤 점에서 이 바람·경계가 형성되었는지

uncertainty.description: 내담자가 자신의 의도에서 아직 정하지 못한 부분. 없으면 빈 문자열

messages.reasoning:

In turn 2, I agreed to contact my friend, but my inner record shows I hadn't actually decided - I was afraid of disappointing the counselor by saying no. I withheld my worry about feeling rejected if there was no response.

In turn 5, I acknowledged that I nodded along because I was afraid of disappointing them, and I recognized that as reading the room (눈치).

What hasn't changed: I still haven't actually contacted the friend. The underlying fear of rejection is still there. I still feel uncertain about whether I'll actually do it. The withheld worry about rejection - that hasn't been resolved.

I should be honest about this. The awareness has shifted - I can see the pattern more clearly. But the actual behavior and the deeper fear haven't changed. I'm still not sure I'll reach out. I might be able to say something about the fear of rejection now, since the counselor's question is specifically asking what hasn't changed, and that's a natural opening.

Let me think about how much to reveal. The turn 5 record says "거절감까지 말해야 할지, 아직은 '실망시킬까 봐'까지만 말해도 충분한 건지 모르겠다." The counselor's question "아직 달라지지 않은 부분은 무엇인가요?" creates a natural space to acknowledge what hasn't shifted. I think I can go a little further - maybe hint at the rejection fear without fully articulating it yet, or perhaps I'm ready to name it since the question specifically asks what hasn't changed.

I think I'll say: I understand the pattern better now (I can see I was reading the room), but the actual feeling of hesitation hasn't gone away. I still don't know if I'll reach out. Maybe I can touch on the worry about no response - the rejection fear - since the question invites me to name what hasn't changed.

Let me draft something natural and honest.
